senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָלַל)cut all around, beheaded, in gen. slain.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 45b:6">Sot. 45ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:1">Deut. XXI, 1</cite>) <he>ח׳ ולא חנוק</he> slain but not strangled, <he>ח׳ ולא מפרפר וכ׳</he> slain but not rolling in dying agony. Ib. IX, 4 <he>ממקום שנעשה ח׳ מצוארו</he> from the place where he has been cut, that means, (the measurement starts) from his throat, v. <cite ref="H01078"><he>חָלָל</he> III</cite>.
Y. Naz. VII, 56ᶜ (ref. to Num. XIX, 18) בח׳ כל שהוא ח׳ beḥalal means whoever is slain, בח׳ זה אבר וכ׳ beḥalal means a severed limb … without sufficient flesh, v. חָלַל, Nif.—

<cite ref="Chullin 3a">Ḥull. 3ᵃ</cite>, a. e. (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 19:16">Num. XIX, 16</cite>) <he>חרב הרי הוא כח׳</he> a sword (with which a person has been killed) has the same levitical status as a slain body.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 8:10:1">Koh. R. to VIII, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 808:2">Yalk. Ps. 808</cite>, a. e. (play on <he>מתחולל</he> <cite ref="Job 15:20">Job XV, 20</cite>) <he>מת וח׳</he> (the wicked man even in his life-time) is dead and beheaded; Tanḥ. Yithro 1 <he>מת חולל</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Job 15:20">ib.</cite> ed. Bub.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲלָלִים</he>.
